label: Figure 1.4: Two-sector circular flow of income
alt: Two-sector circular flow: households and firms joined by four numbered flows, factors of production, wages rent interest and profits, goods and services, and expenditure.
caption: Households and firms are linked by four flows: (1) factors of production pass from households to firms; (2) wages, rent, interest and profits pass from firms to households; (3) goods and services pass from firms to households; (4) expenditure on goods and services passes from households to firms. Red arrows show money flows and purple arrows show real flows.
